paired_evidence: Lightness and environmental medians are reconstructed from the same strict-spatial colour-usable observations within each exact Japan38 concept.

soil.interpretation: Positive direction is exploratory only: it is not significant and cannot preserve the six-concept depth-replicated gate.

decision.interpretation: Removing the evidence-layer mismatch does not rescue current climate or topography as an explanation for the anti-phylogenetic lightness placement. Soil remains a coverage-limited lead rather than a supported mechanism.

next_gate: Recover same-concept radiation/rsds, VPD/aridity and wind/sfcWind evidence if available; improve soil-linked colour coverage, especially JPN_17; then move to historical climate, biotic interactions and population-level colour variation rather than repeatedly retesting BIO1/BIO4/BIO12/BIO15.
claim_boundary: Small observational species-level same-cohort diagnostic on a substitutions/site tree. Pairing reduces evidence-layer mismatch but does not establish causal selection, adaptation, convergence, historical exposure, ancestral colour or evolutionary rate.
